evidence: `gdx-teavm` is a TeaVM backend set for running [libGDX](https://libgdx.com/) applications outside the JVM. It can generate browser builds with JavaScript or Wasm, native C projects for GLFW, experimental iOS native payloads, and Android native app builds through an Android application module.
| `backend-web` | libGDX web runtime plus JavaScript and Wasm build support |
| `gdx-freetype-web` | FreeType support for TeaVM web builds |
| `gdx-freetype-c` | FreeType support for TeaVM C native builds |

The optional `webDefaults {}` block supplies conventions shared by JavaScript and Wasm. It does not declare a target: `js {}` and `wasm {}` still do that, and either block can set all of its own properties instead. Unnamed blocks keep the task names shown above; named blocks such as `js("release") { ... }` create isolated variants and tasks such as `gdx_teavm_web_js_release_build` and `gdx_teavm_web_js_release_run`.
